prompts.prompt: A phptprealistic, cinematic photograph of a man enjoying an espresso at an outdoor cafe on a sun-drenched street in a Tuscan hill town. He has a confident, pensive expression, wearing dark, classic Wayfarer-style sunglasses. The man is dressed in a loose-fitting, unbuttoned cream linen button-down shirt over a white undershirt, paired with loose-fitting white linen trousers. He is seated comfortably in a traditional wooden-frame café chair with a woven rattan seat, leaning back with a natural posture, his right arm resting on the round, white marble-topped café table. On the table, there is a small white ceramic espresso cup with a saucer and a glass of water with a slice of lemon. A glass vase with small white and purple wildflowers (daisies and wild asters) adds a touch of nature. The man is looking out towards the right of the frame. The setting is an old stone-walled café with a warm, aged patina. To the left, a traditional wooden-framed blackboard menu hangs on the wall, listing in white chalk. The street is narrow, with old stone buildings cascading down the hill in the background under a clear, bright vivid blue sky with a few distant birds in flight. The afternoon sunlight is strong and directional, coming from the right, casting defined, warm shadows and highlighting the texture of the linen fabric and the stone architecture. The shot is at eye level, a medium shot that captures the man, table, and setting details. The background is softly blurred with a shallow depth of field (bokeh). The color temperature is warm and inviting, with a rich, filmic quality. The camera used is a full-frame digital camera with a 50mm f/1.8 lens, ultra sharp skin and hair texture. The tone is relaxed, and evocative of a European vacation. Aspect ratio 4:5.
